authority: Repository deployment/init/ProtocolRegistry publication authority; not live-chain deployment evidence.

initialVerifiedGatewayVerifier.activationRule: Governance must call setVerifier with a nonzero code-bearing qualified verifier before use.

initializationOrder: materialize VerifiedGateway420 at frozen 0x0438 with verifier=address(0)

deploy BridgeChainRegistry420, BridgeAssetRegistry, BridgeRouteRegistry, BridgeRiskManager, BridgeTransferRegistry, BridgeAccountingRegistry, GatewayRouter420 and CADCBridgeIntegration from the exact qualified source/compiler inputs
verify runtime code exists and record runtime code hashes for every deployment output
register VerifiedGateway420 and all registry-resolved Bridge components in ProtocolRegistry with version 1.0.0 and ACTIVE lifecycle
verify each ProtocolRegistry resolution, runtime code hash and protocolVersion
configure BridgeChainRegistry420 from chain-identities-v1.json; keep local 420 inactive until its canonical network fingerprint is frozen
configure BridgeAssetRegistry only from canonical asset identities; unqualified assets remain APPROVED_INACTIVE
configure GatewayRouter420 adapters only when adapterId() exactly matches the registered adapter ID and required production verifier dependencies exist
configure BridgeRouteRegistry routes from qualified chain/asset/adapter/verifier inputs; routes remain APPROVED_INACTIVE until both chain identities are active
configure BridgeRiskManager route and asset limits from risk-limits.json
trust only GatewayRouter420 in BridgeRiskManager and BridgeTransferRegistry; add lifecycle operators only by explicit governance decision
apply BridgeAccountingRegistry reconciliation evidence before enabling any asset movement; UNKNOWN accounting remains fail-closed
configure CADCBridgeIntegration only from issuer-approved code-bearing CADC/Endpoint/OFT contracts and keep inactive until qualification
install a code-bearing VerifiedGateway420 verifier by governance before approving gateway assets or enabling gateway movement
enable route directions last, after all preceding checks pass
governancePostconditions: all configuration mutations execute through GovernanceTimelock@0x0429 and canonical GovernanceAuthority checks
ProtocolRegistry remains the sole component-discovery authority at 0x0434
no Bridge component deployment grants custody/governance authority by registration alone
emergency/system-safety semantics remain enforced by each Bridge contract

retiredAddressPolicy.rule: Registry-resolved Bridge components use independently deployed addresses captured from verified deployment receipts; candidate/reservation addresses are not authority unless separately approved by a future atomic namespace decision.

rollbackRecovery: Before route activation, any failed verification invalidates the candidate deployment; do not patch an unverified address into Registry.
If a component runtime hash or constructor binding is wrong, deploy a corrected instance and publish only the corrected verified address.
If ProtocolRegistry publication is wrong, governance must correct/deprecate the erroneous component revision before route activation.
If adapter/verifier configuration is wrong, keep routes inactive; replace configuration through governance and re-run qualification.
If accounting is UNKNOWN or unhealthy, new movement remains blocked; recovery uses newer distinct reconciliation evidence and does not rewrite settled history.
If a source chain reorg invalidates a transfer, use the canonical lifecycle retry/reorg path; never create a second payout identity.
Live rollback/recovery transaction evidence is BRIDGE-AUDIT-9 scope.
blockersForLiveDeployment: public 420 testnet chain/genesis fingerprint not yet frozen in BridgeChainRegistry420 authority
production adapter/verifier deployments and external gateway addresses require BRIDGE-AUDIT-7/9 qualification
